decks.name: LeetCode #295 - Find Median from Data Stream
decks.description: Design data structure to efficiently find median from stream of integers

cards.question: Find Median from Data Stream: The median is the middle value in an ordered integer list. If the size of the list is even, there is no middle value, and the median is the mean of the two middle values. Implement the MedianFinder class: MedianFinder() initializes the MedianFinder object. void addNum(int num) adds the integer num from the data stream to the data structure. double findMedian() returns the median of all elements so far. Answers within 10^-5 of the actual answer will be accepted.

solutions.name: Sorting
solutions.explanation: Store all numbers in array, sort on every findMedian call. AddNum simply appends to array in O(1). FindMedian sorts entire array in O(n log n), then returns middle element or average of two middle elements depending on odd/even count. Simple but inefficient as repeated sorting wastes work. Total time for m operations: O(m * n log n) where n grows. Space O(n) for storing all numbers.

solutions.name: Heap
solutions.explanation: Maintain two heaps: max-heap for smaller half (small), min-heap for larger half (large). Keep heaps balanced with size difference at most 1. AddNum: insert to appropriate heap based on comparison with large heap root, rebalance if needed. FindMedian: O(1) by checking heap roots. If sizes equal, average both roots; if unequal, return root of larger heap. O(log n) addNum, O(1) findMedian. Space O(n) for heaps. Optimal solution avoiding repeated sorting.
